items.title: STONK surges 250% to $140 million market cap as stock-paired Solana launchpad StonkFun pulls volume to Raydium and Jupiter
items.whyYouShouldCare: The surge in STONK's market cap indicates increased interest in Solana-based projects, potentially boosting liquidity and trading activity on Raydium and Jupiter.

items.title: Robinhood flips Solana in DEX volume: A breakout signal for ETH/SOL?

items.title: Solana’s weekly ETF inflows fell 97% while CME funds became less net short
